quest.title: Desert's Remembrance
quest.description: Soheil's archaeological notes record his desert adventures in his youth. Some of the ruins mentioned may contain treasures and old records. Head into the depths of the desert again to look for them.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Primogem x40, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We explored the Tomb of Carouses.

dialogues.speaker: Soheil
dialogues.text: So you went to the Tomb of Carouses... It's a miniature version of the Mausoleum of King Deshret, just like I said, right? So, any new discoveries?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You recount your exploration of the Tomb of Carouses to Soheil and give him the stone slate.

dialogues.speaker: Soheil
dialogues.text: It sounds like you didn't find anything special. I guess size isn't the only difference between the two locations.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What is it, what is it? It has so many words, so it's got to be valuable, right?

dialogues.speaker: Soheil
dialogues.text: From what I can tell, it's an ordinary fable that features some animals.

dialogues.speaker: Soheil
dialogues.text: But that's okay, I can still squeeze a paper out of this, albeit a short one...

dialogues.speaker: Soheil
dialogues.text: "The Retreat of the Sheep: A Preliminary Study of Environmental Change in the Desert."
